## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-GATE-649-01` — Build the packaged candidate; against a captured copy of the live store the helper self-check verifies, get_storage_summary, get_evidence_lifecycle and explain_growth answer, each detail fault still yields live capacity, and the stuck generation stops with its stated reason. A 15-minute sample of the isolated app after the stop averages below 2% of one core. Candidate verification runs in isolated snapshots and a user-equivalent packaged app; it does not prove the user's installed app changed, which needs separate authorization. Open material findings affecting this rung prevent pass.
- `AC-GATE-649-02` — Re-establish TASK-616 containment and TASK-617 sequential dashboard proofs on this candidate.
